body.prompt: Keep everything in the first reference image exactly the same: same snowy hanok courtyard, composition, camera angle, lighting, colors, the young woman in the plum vest hugging her little son in the red jacket, their faces and expressions, the persimmons, and the miniature clay style; the magpie stays exactly as it is (the character in the second reference: small round chibi magpie, glossy black head, cream-white face and belly, big shiny dark-brown eyes, short black beak, dark navy-blue wings, red knotted neckerchief, small brown leather satchel, no microphone).
